title: CopySlotDraft
_note: Strict structured outputs require EVERY property to appear in 'required', at every nesting level. Conceptually optional fields are required-but-emptyable.

slot.description: Which visual slot this line occupies. The slot IS the visual weight: 'headline' is the largest type on the image, 'badge' is the small highlighted chip, 'spec_primary'/'spec_secondary' are the two numeric callouts, 'offer' is the included-items block, 'feature'/'feature_optional' are the small bottom lines. Use each slot at most once. Omit any slot you have nothing truthful to put in.

text.description: The exact words to print, in the target language, with correct diacritics. Marketplace-headline style: short, uppercase-friendly, no sentence punctuation. This string is printed verbatim onto the image.

source.description: Which part of the supplied product information this line came from, quoted. Every line must trace to the product information. If you cannot trace it, do not emit the line.

copy_slots.description: The marketing copy for one e-commerce main image, distributed across visual slots.

dropped.description: Product facts you deliberately left OFF the image, because a main image must not carry everything. List them so a human can see what was sacrificed and overrule you.

notes.description: One or two sentences on the editorial call you made: what you led with and why, what you cut and why.
